concepts.title: Read a ragged CSV
concepts.why: An AEMO PUBLIC_DAILY file holds several record types of different widths, plus comment rows. Spark reads it as asked; DuckDB and Polars need the columns spelled out and short rows padded; Polars reads one file per call.

panels.code:
read_csv(
  getvariable('scada_daily_paths'),
  skip = 1, header = 0,
  all_varchar = 1,
  columns = { 'I': 'VARCHAR', ... },
  filename = 1,
  null_padding = true,
  ignore_errors = 1,
  auto_detect = false
)

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW raw_scada
  (`I` STRING, `UNIT` STRING, ...)
USING csv OPTIONS (
  path '<folder>/{f1.CSV,f2.CSV}',
  header 'true',
  mode 'PERMISSIVE'
)

SELECT * FROM read_csv('<folder>/f1.CSV',
  has_header => false, skip_rows => 1,
  schema => {'I': 'VARCHAR', 'UNIT': 'VARCHAR', ...},
  missing_columns => 'insert',
  truncate_ragged_lines => true,
  include_file_paths => 'filename')
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM read_csv('<folder>/f2.CSV', ...)

concepts.title: Parse 2026/09/17 04:05:00
concepts.silent: Spark's CAST returns NULL for a slash date instead of an error, so the whole column went NULL with every test green.

panels.code: CAST(SETTLEMENTDATE AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS SETTLEMENTDATE
to_timestamp(SETTLEMENTDATE, 'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss') AS SETTLEMENTDATE

CAST(SETTLEMENTDATE AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS SETTLEMENTDATE
-- TIMESTAMPTZ: Polars main only (pola-rs/polars#29878)

concepts.title: Keep non-zero values
concepts.silent: Spark resolves STRING != 0 by casting the string to INT, which truncates: '0.5' != 0 is false. That dropped 12-16% of the intraday SCADA rows.
concepts.why: Every column of a CSV read is a string until something types it.

panels.code:
WHERE SCADAVALUE != 0
-- the reader already typed SCADAVALUE as DOUBLE
WHERE CAST(SCADAVALUE AS DOUBLE) != 0
WHERE CAST(SCADAVALUE AS DOUBLE) <> 0

concepts.title: Time of day as HHMM
concepts.why: fct_summary.time is HHMM, not minutes past midnight.

panels.code: CAST(strftime(s.SETTLEMENTDATE, '%H%M') AS INT) AS time
CAST(date_format(s.SETTLEMENTDATE, 'HHmm') AS INT) AS time

concepts.title: The last 6 days
concepts.why: fct_summary recomputes every date that could still be stale.

panels.code:
WHERE s.DATE >= (SELECT MAX(DATE) - INTERVAL 6 DAY
                 FROM {{ ref('fct_scada') }})

WHERE s.DATE >= (SELECT date_sub(MAX(DATE), 6)
                 FROM {{ ref('fct_scada') }})

concepts.title: File name without extension
concepts.why: Every fact row keeps the file it came from. The one macro with a dialect branch inside it.

panels.code: split_part(split_part(filename, '/', -1), '.', 1)

substring_index(element_at(split(_fname, '/'), -1), '.', 1)
-- _fname = input_file_name(), captured in the stage table

concepts.title: Pick this run's files
concepts.why: Same rule everywhere: files not folded yet, newest first, at most process_limit. What differs is where the query can run.

panels.code:
pre_hook="SET VARIABLE scada_daily_paths = (
  SELECT list(... || archive_path) FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT archive_path FROM {{ ref('stg_csv_archive_log') }}
    WHERE ... ORDER BY archive_path DESC
    LIMIT {{ env_var('process_limit') }}))"
-- model body: read_csv(getvariable('scada_daily_paths'), ...)

concepts.title: Insert only, never update
concepts.why: The facts only ever add rows. Three engines say it the same way; the other two cannot.

panels.code:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='merge',
    merge_clauses={'when_matched':
      [{'action': 'do_nothing'}]},
    unique_key=spec['unique_key']) }}

{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='merge',
    file_format='delta',
    unique_key=['file', 'DUID',
      'SETTLEMENTDATE', 'INTERVENTION']) }}
-- a matched key UPDATES

{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='append') }}
-- merge_clauses is ignored by dbt-polars,
-- so: append only the files not folded yet

concepts.title: Round to DECIMAL(18, 4)
concepts.silent: Same text, different answer on a tie: Spark rounds HALF_UP, DuckDB HALF_EVEN. parity.py gives the money columns a 1e-7 relative tolerance for exactly this.

panels.code:
CAST(mw AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS mw
-- ties: HALF_EVEN

CAST(mw AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS mw
-- ties: HALF_UP

CAST(mw AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS mw
-- tie rule not measured here
